customManagers.description: Update pinned release versions in scripts/install.sh

prBodyNotes: **Before you merge:** this PR changes only the version. Copy the `linux_amd64` and `linux_arm64` SHA-256 sums from the release's `SHA256SUMS` (Unreal Agent) or `SHA256SUMS.txt` (nono) into `scripts/install.sh`. The `Install check` workflow fails until the sums match. See "Updating pinned versions" in the README.
